🔥 Project Recap｜X9 Cup Shooting Competition Live 🎯

From camera to stream — all in one flow

JYL Broadcast is proud to support the X9 Cup Spring Awakening Rifle & Pistol Shooting Competition, delivering a complete on-site production workflow — from camera operation to final live streaming.

Scope includes:
• Camera crew 🎥
• Director & live switching 🔀
• Graphics packaging 🎨
• Multi-platform live streaming 📡
• On-site technical support ⚙️

📍 Vancouver-based team | Serving North America
